name: permtracker
description: The Department of Labor's live status for any PERM, prevailing wage, H-1B LCA, H-2A, H-2B or CW-1 case, when a pending PERM case is likely to be decided, DOL's queue, visa bulletins, and employer, law firm and occupation records, from permtracker.app.

api_key.title: PERM Tracker API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty to use the shared free limits. A free key from permtracker.app, Settings, API keys, gives you your own.
